values.note: Forest Service developed-dispersed camping: no reservations or fee. Monongahela rules: no more than 14 cumulative days at one site within a 28-day period, then move more than 5 road miles or wait 21 days; vehicles must stay on or adjacent to roads open to public travel.

booking.source: Monongahela NF release reprinted by Parsons Advocate 2023-04-24 (https://parsonsadvocate.com/news/pa-top-stories/headlines/monongahela-national-forest-issues-reminder-about-camping-and-food-storage-regulations/: 'developed-dispersed campsites available free of charge'; 'Cheat-Potomac Ranger District (304-257-4488 or 304-478-2000): ... Lower Glady Dispersed Camping (Forest Road 162)'; 'Exceeding the 14-day maximum length of stay within a 28-day period') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/general-use-restrictions (Forest Order: 14 cumulative days within a 28-day period outside developed campgrounds), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service 2026 opening date; 'dates are subject to change based on local weather conditions'. No closing date published.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation ('2026 Recreation Opening Dates ... Cheat-Potomac Ranger District in the Elkins and Parsons areas: ... Lower Glady Dispersed Camping (Forest Road 162) — 4/15'), read 2026-10-22

summary: The Forest Service lists 'Lower Glady Dispersed Camping (Forest Road 162)' among the Cheat-Potomac District's free developed-dispersed areas, opening 4/15 in 2026: booking confirmed (first-come, no reservations, 14 days in 28; platform none added) and season recorded as opening Apr 15 (no closing date). No FS page for the area itself. Fees ($0) left. Note (AWH) unchanged.
